newsitem.title: USA: Tropical Storm Isidore weakens in distant Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Tropical Storm Isidore weakens in distant Atlantic.

text.p: Tropical Storm Isidore continued to weaken on Monday as it spun through the north Atlantic far from land, the National Hurricane Centre said.
At 5 p.m. EDT (2100 GMT), Isidore's centre was near latitude 29.3 north and longitude 40.2 west, or about 950 miles (1,500 km) southwest of the Azores.
Isidore was moving northward near 17 mph (28 kph) and that motion was expected to continue for the next 24 hours, a track that would keep the tropical storm far from land.
Maximum sustained winds were near 50 mph (80 kph).
